provenance_disposition: retain immutable pointer and replacement audit section6
body:
Superseded by the independently reviewed replacement PR 600 at
`8e1c46b1e8ff92dbcce4ccbf2fde17c7c861c2d4` (approval 5246260120; all exact-head
CI and review gates green). The replacement preserves the substantive
seed-indexed soundness proof and main's public helper rename, and records
the still-open printed-route gaps under issue 527. Integration of the
replacement is staged through the daemon; this closure does not claim
that PR 600 is already merged.

The original author audit remains available at its immutable source:
[2026-09-12 issue-527 audit](https://github.com/Dengnifer/MIPStarRE-A/blob/ac7cd808af2db7204ca2f056e38298f3b647d950/audits/2026-09-12-issue-527-ld-soundness.md).
MAIN accepts this provenance pointer and section 6 of the replacement audit
as the retained historical record, as authorized by the meta. The original
branch and commits are preserved. Issue 527 remains open for the source
gaps; no source theorem is marked complete by closing this obsolete PR.
